labs.lab_name: Joint Center for Housing Studies of Harvard University
labs.research_summary: A Harvard research center on US housing, producing the annual State of the Nation's Housing report, working papers, data tools, events and student fellowships.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 managing director, 4 senior research fellows, 1 postdoctoral fellow, 1 housing design fellow, 4 senior research associates, 2 program directors, 3 research analysts, 2 research assistants, 5 finance, communications, events and publications staff
labs.join_notes: The job openings page says there are no open positions at this time. The About page describes fellowships and grants for Harvard graduate and doctoral students and postdoctoral fellowships.
labs.notes: The page's media contact email belongs to the communications director and is not recorded; the page asks that researchers not be emailed. Fax (617) 496-9957. Fellows and advisors, faculty and the Policy Advisory Board are on separate pages and not counted.

notes: Count is the 23 names on the staff page.
